score_kind: heuristic visual similarity (not a calibrated probability)
verdict: Render closely matches the original: same triangle A1B1M2 with M2 at the circle centre and the circle through the lower part of the figure, but the circle is slightly smaller and the triangle's top side sits lower and narrower.

figure_type.original: Isosceles-style triangle A1B1M2 (apex M2 at circle centre) with a circle centred on M2 and extending below it; top side A1B1 horizontal; no visible right-angle marks.
figure_type.render: Same triangle A1B1M2 with M2 at circle centre and a circle below; top side horizontal; no right-angle marks.

issues.description: The rendered circle is smaller than the original: its top sits about 24 px lower in the panel (original top ≈153 px, render ≈177 px), so the radius is roughly 5% smaller, while the bottom of the circle is about the same. The centre appears shifted slightly down relative to the original.
issues.suggestion: Increase the circle radius by about 5% and re-centre it on M2 so that the top and bottom extents match the original.

issues.description: The top side A1B1 is drawn about 30 px lower than in the original and the vertices A1 and B1 are about 10 px further inward, so the top side is shorter than the original (roughly 340 px vs 362 px).
issues.suggestion: Raise A1 and B1 to the original height and move them outward so the top side matches the original width, keeping M2 at the circle centre.

issues.description: Because A1 and B1 are displaced, sides A1M2 and M2B1 are slightly shorter and steeper than in the original. They still meet at M2 and cross the circle at similar points.
issues.suggestion: Adjust A1 and B1 coordinates as above so both legs match the original lengths and angles.

issues.description: The M2 label is set in upright math italic, whereas the original uses bold subscript "2" (M_{\mathbf{2}}). The position is close to the original.
issues.suggestion: Set the label to M_{\mathbf{2}} to match the bold subscript.

issues.description: The detected short segment seg_04 near the M2 label has no visible counterpart in the original and is not clearly drawn in the render.
issues.suggestion: Verify the detection of seg_04 against the source; if it is an artifact, exclude it from the geometry state.

issues.description: Checklist: segment seg_03 is visible but misplaced.
issues.suggestion: Move this element to match the original.
